title: Symbol-value constraint
statement: Given a Boolean-valued function $v$ on atoms, an optional tape position $\tau$, a bit $s$, a time-word tag $T$, and an auxiliary-word tag $A$, define an optional bit as follows: if $v$ is true on the answer atom with symbol selector $(\tau,s,1)$ and tags $T,A$, return no value; otherwise return the value of $v$ on the corresponding answer atom with selector $(\tau,s,0)$ and the same tags.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic finite-state machine M over Bool
